title: Smoother, more reliable play
body: This update includes speed and reliability improvements to help Expert run smoothly. Temporary connection problems now get a quiet retry, so you can get back to playing with less interruption.

title: Keep moving through unfinished clues
body: With Clues set to Off and a word list open in Resources, finishing the selected clue automatically takes you to the next unfinished one. Clues and Resources move together, changing word length when needed.

title: Spot possible dice conflicts
body: Some words in Resources now have a light grey background. Hover over one to see why its letters may conflict with the reference Big Boggle dice. These are hints, not confirmed Babble rules, and you can still click a word to try it.

title: Keep your own progress journal
body: Your personal progress journal builds up puzzle stats as you play. This update turns recording on, including if it was previously off. Visit Options → Personal progress journal to see word counts, longest words and active playing time. Everything stays on this device, and you can pause recording any time. Your choice will be remembered.
